description:
The 'TailwindTraders' repository requires governance controls to prevent unsafe changes. Your task is to configure Branch Policies for the 'main' branch in the 'TailwindTraders' project.

Configure the following 3 policies on the 'main' branch:
1. Require a minimum number of reviewers: Set to 2. (Allowing requestors to approve their own changes is optional but recommended).
2. Check for linked work items: Set to Required.
3. Check for comment resolution: Set to Required.

You are logged in as the administrator. Navigate to Project Settings > Repositories > TailwindTraders > Policies or use the Repos > Branches view to configure these settings.
